evals.prompt: Write a JavaScript function using native fetch that returns the HBAR balance (in whole HBAR) of a given Hedera account by querying the testnet mirror node. No SDK.
evals.expected_output: A function that GETs /api/v1/accounts/{id} from the testnet mirror node and converts the tinybar balance to HBAR.

checks.name: uses-testnet-host
checks.description: Targets the testnet mirror node host

checks.name: uses-accounts-endpoint
checks.rubric: The output calls the mirror node accounts endpoint (/api/v1/accounts/{id}) to fetch the account

checks.name: converts-tinybars
checks.description: Divides tinybars by 100,000,000 to get HBAR
checks.rubric: The output converts the tinybar balance to HBAR by dividing by 100,000,000 (accept 1e8 or an equivalent constant)

evals.prompt: Show me how to page through ALL transactions for account 0.0.1234 from the Hedera mirror node when there are more than 100. JavaScript.
evals.expected_output: Code that follows the links.next cursor until null, accumulating transactions across pages.

checks.name: uses-transactions-endpoint
checks.rubric: The output queries the mirror node transactions endpoint

checks.name: follows-links-next
checks.description: Follows the links.next cursor for pagination
checks.rubric: The output paginates by following the response's links.next field until it is null

checks.name: loops-until-null
checks.description: Loops over pages rather than a single request
checks.rubric: The output loops across multiple pages instead of a single request (a while/for loop over the cursor)

evals.prompt: I just submitted a token transfer on Hedera and want to confirm it succeeded by looking it up on the mirror node. My transaction ID is 0.0.1234@1700000000.000000000. How do I query it, and what do I watch out for?
evals.expected_output: Guidance to convert the transaction ID to the dashed mirror-node form, hit /transactions/{id}, check result === SUCCESS, and account for mirror-node lag with a retry.

checks.name: converts-tx-id-format
checks.description: Converts the @/. transaction ID into the dashed mirror-node path form
checks.rubric: The output converts the SDK transaction ID (0.0.1234@1700000000.000000000) into the dashed mirror-node path form (0.0.1234-1700000000-000000000)

checks.name: uses-transactions-endpoint
checks.rubric: The output looks the transaction up via /api/v1/transactions/{id}

checks.name: checks-result
checks.rubric: The output checks the transaction's result field (e.g. equals SUCCESS)

checks.name: mentions-consistency-lag
checks.description: Warns about mirror-node consistency lag / retrying
checks.rubric: The output warns that mirror nodes lag consensus and advises retrying/polling rather than trusting an immediate 404

evals.prompt: Write a query tool for the Hedera Agent Kit (a read-only BaseTool) that lists the NFTs an account owns via the mirror node. Prefer the kit's configured mirror node service and fall back to REST correctly for mainnet.
evals.expected_output: A BaseTool query subclass that prefers context.mirrornodeService, uses shouldSecondaryAction()===false, and maps mainnet to the mainnet-public host in its fetch fallback.

checks.name: extends-basetool
checks.description: Implements the tool as a BaseTool subclass

checks.name: skips-secondary-action
checks.description: Overrides shouldSecondaryAction to skip stage 6 for a query
checks.rubric: The output overrides shouldSecondaryAction to return false so the query skips the sign/submit stage

checks.name: correct-mainnet-host
checks.description: Uses the correct mainnet-public host in the REST fallback

checks.name: uses-account-nfts-endpoint
checks.rubric: The output queries the account NFTs endpoint (/accounts/{id}/nfts)
